id./param/talk_party/talk_party_a070.pack|t: Our duty as sisters is to lead you, the Luminary, to Yggdrasil. Then many of your questions should be answered.
Our duty as sisters is to lead you, the Luminary, to Yggdrasil. Then many of your questions should be answered.
The path to Yggdrasil is the mystery, but if we get the rainbow-colored branch tied to the tree, we may learn how.
The path to Yggdrasil is the mystery, but if we get the rainbow-colored branch tied to the tree, we may learn how.
Come on, no dawdling here. Let's go back to Gallopolis to get the Rainbough.
Not long ago, sister and I traveled the deserts around here searching for you, {var:1}.
Not long ago, sister and I traveled the deserts around here searching for you, {var:1}.
Yes, sister wasn't in her small form then. Hee hee, how nostalgic.
Yes, sister wasn't in her small form then. Hee hee, how nostalgic.
Hey, {var:1}... That Sylvando tagged along pushily. Is it really okay?
We're technically on the run. Staying with someone this flashy will make us stand out...
Sylvando's a bit odd, but seems fun, and plenty strong too!
He won't hold us back, and if he helps with the capture, it's not a bad deal.
Sylvando, who was so great at the circus and the Faris Cup the other day, helping us is reassuring!
Sylvando seems to know how to fight, so he'll be a great help against the tough desert killer.
West along the road are two checkpoints. The north one leads to the Celestial Sands, where the scorpion appeared.
Come, {var:1}. Let's chase the young prince and hurry to the Celestial Sands!
Sylvando readily believes the Luminary legend and the evil god's revival... He's a strange one.
...Well, I'm one to talk. Let's catch the desert killer and get that Rainbough.
That useless prince went ahead into the Celestial Sands. All bluster, honestly...
Come, {var:1}. I'm a bit worried about that prince too, so let's go to the desert killer in the Celestial Sands!
Why did the Sultan have us capture the desert killer? He could've just had it killed on the spot.
If he wanted to show off the prince's achievement to everyone... what a doting father.
The exchange between Sylvando and the prince keeps nagging at me. The prince isn't satisfied with himself...
...Not quite satisfying, but we should get the Rainbough now. Let's go back to Gallopolis.
Sylvando... has gone off somewhere. A reliable person, though only for a short time.
The prince's party seems to have returned to Gallopolis with the captured monster. Shall we go too, for the Rainbough?
He's a bit loud, but definitely a strong fighter. Sylvando joining isn't bad.
Now, {var:1}. Let's head to Gondolia to look for the merchant with the Rainbough.
Great, {var:1}! With Sylvando's ship we can adventure the open sea and go to new places!
...Still, owning a ship... Sylvando must be someone amazing! Who is he, really?
With Sylvando along, the journey ahead feels much more reassuring and lively.
Traveling alone with sister is a fond memory, but traveling with companions like this is nice too.
Gondolia, where my darling ship is resting, is far ahead past the west checkpoint of the Gallopolis region.
Hee hee, with you, {var:1}, I can look forward to an exciting adventure. Take care of me!
Now, the circus! The circus! Watching the popular circus for free, how lucky we are!
You get it, {var:1}? We meet in front of the circus tent tonight! Don't be late and keep the prince waiting!
I've never seen a circus before. I'm so excited...
I'm curious what a prince who'd give up a national treasure wants, but first, let's enjoy the circus.
Geez, that prince was a letdown. Even for the Rainbough, we took on a troublesome favor.
But that Sylvando entertainer was great. Things turned out like this, but it was lucky we saw it free.
Honestly, that sly prince. "Race if you want the Rainbough"... I get angry just remembering.
Still, a contest is a contest. Practice at the racetrack and win that Faris Cup, you hear?
Everyone in this country seems happy. With the Faris Cup about to start, all of Gallopolis is full of anticipation.
To enter the race, we go to the Race House west of the paddock, per the prince, right?
The Faris Cup is a one-time showdown... It may be lucky to pray for victory at the church first.
Wow, what a roar of cheers. Being with you in your prince disguise, we stand out too...
Well, body double or not, a contest is a contest. We'll cheer from the stands, so go win.
Oh, {var:1}. That outfit suits you. Surely cooler than the real one.
...Well, the Faris Cup is finally starting! Having come this far, there's no turning back!
You're the Luminary, so you'd better win! We'll cheer from the stands!
The people are cheering for {var:1} in the prince's disguise. I feel sorry, as if we're deceiving them.
...But! To get the Rainbough, sometimes one must dirty one's hands! Do your best, {var:1}!
Phew... finally that mess is over. I'm done babysitting the prince.
Prince Faris was summoned by the Sultan and went to Gallopolis Castle.
Come on, {var:1}, to the throne room. Let's grab that Rainbough and ditch this hot country.
Hey, {var:1}! You did well at the Faris Cup! That was a fine ride!
...But it was annoying that you were cheered as the useless prince. Don't lump you with that wimp!
Sylvando, who entered on a whim, was astonishingly fast, yet he seemed not to be going all out.
The circus show was wonderful too. Sylvando is a mysterious person... I'm curious about him.
Just when the festival was lively, we can't leave the monster called the desert killer to worry the kingdom's people.
There have been injuries already, so we can't just stand by. I wish we could help somehow...
That useless prince's party went to the Celestial Sands where the scorpion monster is.
That useless prince's party went to the Celestial Sands where the scorpion monster is.
The Celestial Sands are around the west and north of town, right? Let's hurry after them.
The Celestial Sands are around the west and north of town, right? Let's hurry after them.
So the Great Tree's branch is called the Rainbough. A clue, one step forward... but that prince kept eyeing you.
...I doubt it, but did he see through who you are? If so, he's quite the operator.
The prince's room is down the castle stairs, on the left. He's rumored to be the finest prince ever, so... bad feeling. Be careful.
Lucky start: we got info on the Great Tree's branch... the Rainbough! That's lucky!
Off to the prince's room! You were invited by a prince, so be polite.
The Sultan seemed busy... but at least Prince Faris will hear us out, which is good.
Still, the exchange of knightly maxims between the Sultan and prince surprised me. A truly noble Kingdom of Knights.
He didn't notice you're the Luminary, but that prince... can't be trusted.
I have a bad feeling. We're on the run, so better safe than sorry.
Hear the prince's story at the circus and maybe get the Rainbough. All good news!
The circus tent was on the east side of town. {var:1}, when night comes, go to the tent where we meet!
So the Rainbough is a Gallopolis national treasure. For the prince to ask the Sultan to give it up, how generous.
...I wish sister would learn from him a little.
What is it, {var:1}? That useless prince isn't in the castle.
The prince said he'd wait inside the Race House west of the paddock in town.
Prince Faris said to come to the throne room, right?
Not quite convinced, but let's get the Rainbough from the Sultan and ditch this hot country.
Do the people who watched the Faris Cup really think the prince ran? The body double worked, but it's frustrating.
...Somehow unsatisfying, but the prince's promise is fulfilled. Let's go get the Rainbough.
Seriously... we were so close to the Rainbough. That desert killer has awful timing.
The prince is bad, but the Sultan's doting is shocking too. Not my business, but I worry about this country's future.
No need to say, I know how you feel, {var:1}. Called to the prince's room, you have a bad feeling, right? Me too.
True, I'm not keen, but think of it as getting the national treasure Rainbough and go hear the prince out.
The desert killer... There've been injuries already, so we can't just stand by.
Prince Faris seems to have returned to his room on the first floor of the castle. Shall we go hear the rest?
I'll help capture the scorpion because {var:1} decided so, but it's no good for this country or that useless prince.
The prince said he'd wait at the castle gate in town. Let's chase him and capture the monster quick.
...Well, that prince is truly hopeless, but Serena has a point. Helping this once can't be helped.
Besides, soldiers have been hurt by the desert killer, so we can't leave the monster alone.
Come on! Let's catch the monster quick and take the Rainbough.
To not betray his parents' and the people's expectations, the prince kept lying about himself. That was hurting him.
Bearing the people's expectations as a prince must be a pressure beyond imagining.
Hey, bringing Sylvando here, is that okay?
Hey, bringing Sylvando here, is that okay?
A flashy entertainer might cause a commotion. I shudder to think what if a fuss starts.
Oh, {var:1}, I get it. Coming all the way here means you wanted to see the castle cat.
Hee hee, so soothing. I like the cat here too.
Oh, {var:1}. You brought me to the castle? Thank you, how kind.
Now, having gotten energy from the castle cat, let's go to the Celestial Sands where the prince went and catch the scorpion!
Geez... after humoring the prince's whims so much, we still end up without the Rainbough.
Well, the Sultan reflected, and the prince tried a bit. Think of it as helping a nation's future, not bad.
So, {var:1}, now that we have the next lead, let's head to the town of Gondolia to the west.
Honestly, just when I thought we'd get the Rainbough, selling it for the Faris Cup... I'm speechless.
...But though the prince was hopeless, he grew enough to face a monster alone. Our efforts paid off.
When the desert killer got up, I was scared, but the prince fought bravely.
...And Sylvando knew chivalry well, and with his flowing swordwork, seemed a true master.
Who is Sylvando, really? He was so unique and fun. I hope we meet again somewhere.
Knowing Sylvando, he'll climb somewhere high and cause a commotion. I shudder to think of it.
Oh, the useless prince has reformed and is training. Commendable.
Hmph, that's thanks to us going out of our way. He should thank us more.
As for the young prince, I'm no longer worried.
With the spirit he showed against the scorpion, he'll be fine now. He'll grow up fine.
Hm, so this is the racetrack. Even outsiders like us seem able to enter the horse race.
...But our goal is the Rainbough. Go easy on horse racing and let's get to the prince soon.
Even before the Faris Cup, small races are being held. As expected of a race-loving country.
Hey, {var:1}. To win the Faris Cup, why not warm up here?
The Faris Cup is over, yet races continue. Everyone here loves horses so much.
If you enter again, {var:1}, do your best! We'll cheer for you.
Desert killer or not, this country never stops holding races. Tough, or horse-crazy...
Well, if it's being held, no reason not to join. If you enter, {var:1}, I'll watch carefully.
...Even with the desert killer around, the races go on as usual.
Staying calm and carrying on as usual, the people of Gallopolis are so composed. Worthy of the Kingdom of Knights.
The Faris Cup I ran with you, {var:1}, was thrilling and so fun. I'd like to compete again someday.
...Anyway, our destination is the Celestial Sands where the desert killer appeared. Let's hurry after the young prince.
Oh, {var:1}. Since you're here, why not enter a horse race?
You might win a nice prize, and a break now and then is good.
Oh, {var:1}. You brought me this far? Thank you, how kind.
Oh, {var:1}. You brought me this far? Thank you, how kind.
But our destination isn't here! Let's chase the young prince to the Celestial Sands!
But our destination isn't here! Let's hurry to the depths of the Celestial Sands, chasing the young prince!
Still, Sylvando owning his own ship is a surprise. You can't judge people by looks.
But Gondolia's dock is only for the rich, as I recall... Who is that guy...?
A lot happened, but in the end we didn't find the Rainbough in Gallopolis.
How long will our journey for the Rainbough go on...?
Hee hee, my darling ship is waiting for you, {var:1}. Let's hurry to Gondolia.
This Gondolia Marsh has many tall trees and tangled paths, so watch the map as we walk.
I asked around a bit, and the merchant with the Rainbough isn't in this town anymore.
We'd better chase quick. The dock with the ship is west of town, so let's go there first.
I've only ridden regular ships. Sailing with so few people is a first, so I'm excited.
I don't know if you know, {var:1}, but owning a private ship costs a lot. Sylvando is no ordinary person.
This town is lively and full of all kinds of people. It's so different from our homeland Arboria, so fresh.
{var:1}, shall we look around the shops? There may be rare things.
...Oh no. If I get too excited, they'll think I'm a country bumpkin.
Truth is, I bought my darling ship long ago on a whim. Never thought it'd be useful like this.
My darling ship is a bit old, but well maintained, so rest easy as if on a great ship.
The whole time in Gallopolis, nothing but desert in sight... I get wanting to go where there's water.
But, {var:1}, remember the Rainbough we're after too, later is fine.
...Come to think of it, before meeting you, Serena wandered everywhere, and we ended up in strange places like this.
Our next destination is Gondolia. I'm just telling you, so go to town when you're satisfied.
Sigh... I'm so glad there's plenty of water. While traveling Gallopolis, I was always covered in sand.
By the way, {var:1}, are you perhaps lost? Oh... I hope I'm mistaken.
Oh dear, {var:1}. I was wondering when to say it, but we passed Gondolia.
Checking where you are matters when traveling, so be careful. First, look at the map again.
